
{{alias}}( symbols )
    Converts an array of symbol aliases and/or shorthands to symbol shorthands.

    If unable to resolve a shorthand for an element of the input array, the
    corresponding element in the output array is `null`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    symbols: Array<string>
        Symbol aliases and/or shorthands.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array
        Symbol shorthands.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( [ 'circle', 'square' ] )
    [ 'o', 's' ]
    > v = {{alias}}( [ 'circle', 'beep' ] )
    [ 'o', null ]

    See Also
    --------
